questions.question_text:
A circle has an area of $30\,cm^2$.
What is its radius?
Give your answer to 1 decimal place.

options.why: This radius would produce an area much larger than 30 square centimetres.
This radius would produce an area substantially smaller than 30 square centimetres.
This value does not result from correctly rearranging the circle area formula.

questions.solution_text: Using $A=\pi r^2$, $r=\sqrt{30\div\pi}\approx3.090$. Rounded to 1 decimal place, the radius is $3.1\,cm$.
